title: l1qw.16.4: C gcp_trust slot-claim verify migrates from SLOT_CLAIM: prefix to COSE_Sign1 (three-way interop break)
description: Discovered by worker-4 during l1qw.16.1 prep: the three slot-claim implementations sign incompatible transcript formats TODAY — Rust b'LICHEN-GCP-SLOT-CLAIM-v1'+iid+superframe+seq+slots (slot.rs:723), C b'SLOT_CLAIM:'+opaque message (gcp_trust.h:59, gcp_trust_verify_slot_claim gcp_trust.c:126), Python canonical-CBOR string-keyed map (slot_claim.py). No cross-pair verifies. Fix as part of the coordinated COSE_Sign1 migration (.16.1/.16.2): gcp_trust_verify_slot_claim decodes the COSE_Sign1 envelope (or the shared payload transcript per the .16.1 decision), drops the SLOT_CLAIM: prefix path; update gcp vectors accordingly. Also note the committed gcp_slot_claim.json slot_claim_basic vector's cbor_canonical_hex embeds an indefinite-map fragment (0xbf) that cbor2 cannot decode — regenerate the corpus when migrating (two-suite count contract: python test_vectors + rust consumers).
